lines.text: …I said it would be windy.
…I have twine.
…I was watering a cactus.
…It will rain.
I told her not to laminate it.
…Everybody has a column.
…Oh.
…They were dry.
…She came.
…Hello. You came the long way. Your shoes say so.
…Oh. Hi. I was just telling the hibiscus about you.
…Good morning. The neem tree says good morning too. Quietly.
…Hi. You look thirsty. So does the bougainvillea. One at a time.
…Go gently. Take water.
…Bye. Shade on the left side of the road. It's cooler.
…Thank you. The plants say so too. They're slower about it.
…Sorry. I was listening to the leaves. What did you say?
…You're very patient. Like a cactus. That's a compliment.
…You grew this year. Not taller. Better.
…You overwatered your plant. It told me.
…Lyzzy says you're mysterious. You're just tired.
…I'm coming. Mind the roots.
…It's all right. I'll wait. Seeds wait for years.
…Not this way. The path by the greenhouse. Follow the tomatoes.
…Yes.
…No. Sorry. No.
…Maybe. Ask me after it rains.
…Hmm? I was counting leaves. Again, please.
…Who? There was nobody there fa. Only the wind.
…Mm. Yes. You're right. Lyzzy will say it louder.
…I'd rather not. Thank you for asking first.
…Why was the plant shy? It had a lot of… leaves. Lyzzy, don't laugh.
…Have you had water today? A whole glass?
…We won. Oh. That's nice.
…We lost. Things grow back.
…Oh. I'm fine. You're fine. The fern is upset.
…I'm sitting. I meant to. The grass is soft here.
…It's dark. The moonflowers will open now. Come and see.
…Light. The moonflowers are cross.
…It will rain.
…There. I said.
…Too hot. The leaves are folding. So should we. Shade.
…Garden eggs from the greenhouse. I grew them. Don't tell the Dean.
…Seeds are cheap. Waiting is free.
…For me? Thank you. I'll put it by the window.
…Plastic flowers. That's… thoughtful. They won't need me.
…A cutting. From where? It will grow. Thank you. Truly.
…Shh. You're doing well. Just a bit more sun.
…Lyzzy. Lyzzy. …It's fine. She'll hear in a minute.
…At night the gate flowers close. They're listening.
…I said it would be windy. You were a kite.
…I had twine. I always have twine.
…You're new. So are the seedlings. Welcome, both.
…I water the gate flowers every morning. Nobody asked. They asked.
…The statue by the pond. Her face changes. Or the light does.
…Six statues. Six gazes. They cross. I just had patience.
…Lyzzy took your photo. Seven times. You blinked in all.
…You helped the girl with the gown pins. I saw.
…Tomorrow. Bring your umbrella. Lyzzy won't. She never does.
…The cats in the Engineering Garden. They're sitting in a ring. Shh.
…Hello. The mall took the old mango tree. I'm still a bit cross.
…Kwari Mall. No plants inside. Only plastic ones. They look so tired.
…Emily brought strawberries. I brought soil. We traded. Fair.
…I was watering a cactus. Lyzzy said I missed the whole drama.
…You ran out in the first rain without me telling you. You learn.
…You water the hostel plants when I'm away. They told me.
…Big rain tonight. The first one. Stay off the long road.
…Walk on the grass with me. It likes company.
…You stayed. So did I. The hostel plants needed us.
…Every plant on the floor. Every one. Alive. Through the strike.
…No water in Kadanya. I carry it from the tap by the clinic. Two buckets.
…The farm. The strawberries made it. Emily cried. So did the tractor.
…Lyzzy video calls to show me her plants. They're plastic. I didn't say.
…Strike month six. The weeds won't wait for the lecturers.
…You never forget the stairs plants. Most people forget the stairs plants.
…Dark again. Good. The greenhouse sleeps better.
…Hello. I got a letter. I won't say who from. It smelled like rain.
…Lyzzy laminated the wall chart. Laminate is forever. Feelings aren't.
…There's a column for you. There's a column for everyone. Even the goat.
…It will rain. It did. The eel listened.
…They were dry. The gate flowers. That day. I watered them anyway.
…You and the double booking. Your column was very full.
…You stood up for Lyzzy. After the clip. She needed that.
…Kelechi's last statue. Five hands, and a space. Don't sit in the space.
…Final year. The seedlings we planted in first year are trees now.
…Tunde drew the greenhouse. He drew a plant I don't have. I'll grow it.
…Lyzzy is filming everything. I'm watering everything. We're the same.
…Convocation. I still think about who came. I won't say. You saw.
…You grew. Slowly. Properly. Like the good ones.
…After convocation, visit the gate flowers. They'll know you.
…It will rain at convocation. Only a little. Only after.
…New freshers. Like seedlings. Mostly water. Lots of noise.
…Exam week. I read under the neem tree. It hums. Helps.
…I passed. So did the hibiscus. It flowered.
…Allowance. Potting soil. Lyzzy says that's not a treat. It is.
…Market day. Seeds from the old woman by the gate. She never charges me.
…Cup final. Lyzzy is screaming. I'm holding her lip gloss.
…Everybody's leaving. The trees stay. So will I. For a while.
…Iftar under the stars. I brought hibiscus tea. Zobo, from the greenhouse.
…Christmas. I ask the porter to water my plants. He forgets. They forgive.
…Valentine's. Somebody left a rose at the greenhouse. Wrong place. Nice thought.
…Harmattan. Everything is thirsty. Me too. Mostly the ferns.
